Application Data.NAME: Sweet Cream Dairy Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sweet Cream Dairy Co. operates a quaint dairy and ice cream shop specializing in handcrafted ice cream and dairy-based desserts. Our menu features a variety of classic and innovative flavors, prepared from locally sourced ingredients. We offer a selection of artisanal waffle cones made fresh daily. The shop does not conduct any cooking or heating processes requiring fire suppression systems. Additionally, we do not sell alcoholic beverages, ensuring that we maintain a family-friendly atmosphere. Customer orders can be placed online, though we handle all payment data securely in compliance with data protection standards. We pride ourselves on transparency with ingredient sourcing, highlighting our commitment to quality and sustainability.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Mandatory Fire Suppression Systems: Any dairy or ice cream shop conducting cooking
or heating processes on-site (e.g., waffle cone preparation) must have an approved, regularly
inspected fire suppression system installed over cooking equipment. This requirement reduces
the risk of fire-related losses and aligns with local fire codes.
• Cyber Coverage Eligibility: Cyber liability coverage is only available if the business main-
tains online ordering platforms or stores customer payment data electronically (e.g., POS
systems). This restriction ensures coverage is aligned with actual cyber exposure.
• Liquor Liability Requirement: If the shop sells alcoholic beverages (e.g., ice cream cock-
tails or dairy-based alcoholic desserts), liquor liability coverage is mandatory to address the
increased liability risks associated with alcohol service.
